relationships.subject: pioglitazone
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results showed a significant reduction in serum levels of IL-8 and MCP-1in pioglitazone-treated rats to an extent similar to that of normal healthy counterparts.

relationships.subject: pioglitazone
relationships.evidence_quote: Pioglitazone administration resulted in a significant rise in SOD and CAT levels together with a decrease in MDA levels

relationships.subject: GW9662
relationships.evidence_quote: Blocking the PPAR-γ pathway, though administration of GW9662, counteracted pioglitazone protective effects.

key_findings: Pioglitazone relieved fatigue, improved muscle performance, reduced IL-8/MCP-1 and restored antioxidants in reserpine fibromyalgia rats.
PPAR-gamma antagonist GW9662 aggravated fibromyalgia manifestations.
